about: Stage 1 knobs (plan claude-docs/stage1_plan_20261014, revision 1). Numbers here are either set by the plan or measured in Stage 0 (configs/control/stage0_facts.json) and copied with their source; values Stage 1 measures go to configs/control/stage1_facts.json instead.

tray.note: centre on the +x wall's centre line, 0.2 m between the tray edge and the wall

layout.note: plan 1A: toys >= 0.25 m from walls, >= 0.35 m from the tray centre, >= 0.2 m apart, >= 0.5 m from the robot start; robot_wall_clear_m keeps the start off the walls

grasp.note: p = 1 - (e / tol_xy)^2 for the nearest toy within tol_xy and tol_z of the mouth tip (microduck-lab world/arena.py:1573-1631; decision 8B tolerance 4 cm). The sim reports a closed mouth holding a toy at -5 deg + blocked_deg_per_cm x the toy's smaller cross-section (an abstraction of a stalled servo); our code calls it held above held_threshold_deg

pick.note: Stage 0: beak lowest at phase 0.29, training holds it down to 0.425, lab closes at 0.38; H2 pick lands the beak 8.0 cm ahead and 1.46 cm left of the trunk (stage0_facts ground_pick.landing_in_trunk_frame_cm.mac_H2)

camera.note: the sim head camera (mjlab_microduck/sim/camera.py): 640x360 on its side, fovy 45 deg across the 360 px axis; the detector sees it turned upright (360 wide x 640 high, np.rot90 k=3); frame = which image robot.state frames.camera's OpenCV axes describe: 'upright' (checked in the cloud twin 2026-10-14: projections land within ~10 px of the oracle box centre, 'raw' is 50-200 px off)

colour.note: OpenCV-style HSV (H 0-180, S and V 0-255). Set from cloud renders 2026-10-14 (H2 at 0.12/0.22 m, H1 at 0.35/0.55 m, 2 headings, both floors): bus H 19-30 S ~216; Henry H 52-57 S ~121; ketchup H 1-3 S ~215; floors: blue checker H ~105, light wood H 16-30 S 61-117 (so yellow needs S >= 150); green crocodile H 28-44, blue Thomas H ~105. Checked again in 1D
